title: Smiling Young Boy in Backyard Garden, July 1950 Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A charming black and white vintage snapshot from July 1950 featuring a young boy identified as Michael at four and a half years old. He stands smiling in a sunny backyard with lush foliage and a brick wall in the background, dressed in a classic white short-sleeve shirt and high-waisted dark trousers with deep front pockets. The photo features decorative deckled edges typical of mid-20th century amateur snapshots.
